FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP.title: NP
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP.description:
1. When you play a non-Noble card, gain {NpRate}%[gold]NP[/gold]per energy spent.
2. Gain[gold]NP[/gold]equal to attack damage taken.
3. At 100%+, you can use your Noble Phantasm.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_STAR.title: Critical Stars
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_STAR.description: At 10+ stars, your next attack deals double damage and consumes 10 stars.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP_DAMAGE.title: NP Damage
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP_DAMAGE.descript: Increases NP attack damage by this percentage.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_CRITICAL_DAMAGE.de: Increases critical hit damage by this percentage.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_EVIL_CURSE.title: Evil Curse
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_EVIL_CURSE.descrip: At the start of turn, lose HP equal to curse stacks.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_COMMAND_SPELL.desc:
[gold]Noble Phantasm Release[/gold]: Gain 100% [gold]NP[/gold].
Activated by using 1 [gold]Command Spell[/gold].

[gold]Spiritron Repair[/gold]: Restore 30 HP.
Activated by using 1 [gold]Command Spell[/gold].

[gold]Spiritron Restoration[/gold]: Survive fatal damage and restore all HP.
Gain 300% [gold]NP[/gold].
Activates when you are about to be defeated, consuming 3 [gold]Command Spells[/gold].
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NOBLE.description: [gold]Noble Phantasm[/gold] has [gold]Retain[/gold] and remove from the combat when played.
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NOBLE.title: Noble Phantasm
FGO_CARDPILE_NOBLE.description:
Your[gold]Noble Deck[/gold].

Right-click the[gold]Saint Quartz[/gold]relic to add more Noble cards.

FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_COOLDOWN.title: Cooldown
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_COOLDOWN.descripti: While Cooldown is greater than 0, this card cannot be played. Playing any card reduces Cooldown by 1. Becomes playable once Cooldown reaches 0, then re-enters Cooldown after being played.
